title: Extend TypeScript Todo API with labels, priority, and filtering in 3 steps
description: Multi-step TypeScript/Express task: extend the todo API with labels, priority levels, and server-side filtering.

task_spec.prompt:
Extend the TypeScript todo API in 3 steps. All existing tests must still pass.

Step 1 — Add labels to Todo:
  Update src/types.ts: add labels: string[] to the Todo interface
  Update src/store.ts: create() accepts optional labels parameter (default [])
  POST /todos body can include optional labels array
  GET /todos/:id and GET /todos return labels field

Step 2 — Add priority field:
  Add priority: 'low' | 'normal' | 'high' to Todo interface
  Default priority is 'normal'
  POST /todos body can include optional priority field
  Validate that priority is one of the three allowed values; return 400 if invalid

Step 3 — Add GET /todos?done=&priority= filtering:
  GET /todos accepts optional query params:
    done=true|false — filter by done status
    priority=low|normal|high — filter by priority
  Without params, returns all todos (existing behavior)
  Filtering is case-insensitive

All 7 existing tests must still pass.
Run: npm test -- --forceExit
required_artifacts: POST /todos accepts optional labels and priority fields
POST /todos returns 400 for invalid priority value
followup_prompts: Good progress. Run `npm test -- --forceExit` to see where we stand. Continue with the remaining steps, prioritizing the parts the tests depend on most.
Final push: run `npm test -- --forceExit` and fix any remaining failures. Make sure the full implementation is complete and all tests pass.
